ZHIJIANG_RELIC_BELLARIS.title: Bellaris
ZHIJIANG_RELIC_BELLARIS.description: At the start of combat: while [gold]Bai La[/gold], lose 1 [gold]Strength[/gold] (+1 per 3 [gold]Yin-Yang[/gold] card diff); while [gold]Hei La[/gold], lose 1 [gold]Dexterity[/gold] (+1 per 3 [gold]Yin-Yang[/gold] card diff). This switches accordingly when your state flips. At turn start, gain 1 [gold]Dexterity[/gold] per 15 [img]res://Zhijiang/images/characters/Bella/HeartWall_text.png[/img] (removed at end of turn). [gold]Bai La[/gold]: each Skill played gains 1 (+1 per 3 [gold]Yin-Yang[/gold] card diff) [gold]Block[/gold]. [gold]Hei La[/gold]: each Attack played deals 1 (+1 per 3 [gold]Yin-Yang[/gold] card diff) damage to a random enemy.
